header.contentDescription: Chat with Léa: a dozen messages about a Saturday hike, the latest at the bottom, and a composer with a send button

messages.text: Still on for the hike on Saturday?
Yes! Which trail did you pick in the end?
The loop above Lac Blanc. 14 km, about 900 m of climbing.
The forecast says sun until 3, then clouds.
Train leaves Lyon Part-Dieu at 07:12, I booked two seats in coach 4.
Amazing, thank you! I'll bring sandwiches and the first-aid kit.
Do you still have my blue thermos from last time?
I do, it's by the door so I don't forget it again.
